title: Witherfall - They Will Let You Down

lines.l: As to the light is too short
We only have a chance to show what we will bring
So many people are relieved to count the dead gods
So stand with me if not
Cause they will let you down
Yes, they will let you down
Can they laugh when it's over Cursing you under their breath
Pretending to care, but always too late We look past their flaws
In summits and devils we meet
Life is still strong, the criminal of our trivial things
We only have a chance to show what we will bring
So many people are releasing out what they can't
Until the bitter truth shows them what they have known
Cause they will let you down
Yes, they will let you down
